## About
Darring's Detail is a hands-on auto detailing shop in Indianapolis. Roderick Darring started dreaming of running his own detailing company back in middle school, and customers today know him as Rod.
We handle deep cleaning, paint protection film (also called clear bra), ceramic coating, window tinting and paintless dent repair, including hail damage. Our promise is simple: honesty, value and good service, no matter what you drive or how much work it needs.
You'll find us at Ditch Road, right next to Jiffy Lube, a short drive from Zionsville, Carmel, Fishers and Westfield. We want your visit to feel like home and family, and our neighbors have given us a 4.9 rating from 161 Google reviews.

## Services
- Auto detailing: Inside and out deep cleaning. One reviewer brought in a work truck caked in mud and asphalt, and another said their SUV, shared with toddlers, came back looking and smelling brand new.
- Paint protection film (clear bra): Clear film that guards your paint from wear. One reviewer had their old film removed and replaced, and said Rod even took off the headlight assemblies to wrap the film around the sheet metal.
- Ceramic coating: A ceramic coating to protect your paint and keep it looking sharp.
- Window tinting: Window tint installed at the shop, with films like LLumar and XPEL.
- Paintless dent repair: Dents pulled without repainting, including hail damage.

## FAQ
Q: Can I just stop by?
A: Yes. You can stop by any weekday, Monday through Friday. We're closed on weekends.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're on the southwest corner at Ditch Road, right next to Jiffy Lube.

Q: How fast will I hear back if I send a message?
A: Someone will get back to you within 24 hours. For a faster answer, give us a call.
